primary.note: Same value as ink; the primary button reads as dense ink, not a brand colour.

on-primary.note: Dark theme: equals ground-dark (#262624). primary in dark theme equals ink-dark (#f0eee6).

on-stage.note: No dark override; used on the stage in both themes.

title-lg.purpose: Camera name in the header bar; confirmation card title.

title.purpose: Card titles such as the next-step heading; balanced wrap.

body.purpose: Messages and captions; prose capped at 68ch; tabular numerals in captions.

body-strong.purpose: Buttons, health word, disclosure summaries, plan values; primary buttons at 600.

label.purpose: Muted dt labels and checkbox sub-lines.

mono.purpose: Machine values inside Technical details only.

extensions.shadowsNote: The shipped build uses no shadows. style.css defines an unused --shadow custom property; it is not part of the system.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on controls; chevron rotation.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Confirmation card entrance: fades in from 6px below.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The single busy spinner on a working step title.

motion.name: reduced-motion

breakpoints.name: wide

narrative.overview:
ThorVision's browser view is a twin of the Claude Code desktop panel, set beside a scientist's agent chat. It reads as part of the host tool rather than a product with its own brand: a warm off-white (or warm charcoal) ground, white hairline-bordered cards with gently rounded corners, and system UI type at panel sizes. Most of the page is neutral. The live video sits on a near-black stage and is the most visually prominent thing on the page.

Density is calm and vertical. The page works first as a 360 to 480 px side panel and opens out into two columns in a full tab. Each card has one clear action. Secondary controls are quiet text buttons, and the machinery (earlier analyses, storage, technical details) sits behind chevron disclosures divided by hairlines. Colour is used only for state: green means live, amber means attention, red means fault, and clay marks a change that is ready to run. Clay also marks keyboard focus.

Both themes are first-class. The light theme is the default. The dark theme follows `prefers-color-scheme` unless `data-theme` forces one or the other. Every role has a paired dark value.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral ground with white hairline cards. Depth comes from tone and 1px lines, never from shadows.
System UI type from 12 to 16 px. Hierarchy comes from weight and muted colour, not from size jumps.
One filled ink button per card. Outlined secondary buttons and borderless quiet buttons carry everything else.
Colour is reserved for state (success, warning, error, clay suggestion) and for focus.
A near-black video stage with rounded corners, the same in both themes.
Disclosures with CSS chevrons and hairline separators hold the technical detail.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only when it carries state (live, attention, fault, ready change) or focus. Everything else uses the warm neutrals. If removing a colour would lose no information, the colour should not be there.

rules.name: The Paired Line Rule
rules.body: Every state that tints a card's border has its own low-contrast `-line` partner (`clay-line`, `warning-line`, `error-line`). A full-strength state hue is never used as a card border.

rules.name: The Dark Stage Rule
rules.body: The video stage stays near-black in both themes. Processed video is judged against a dark surround, so the stage never follows the page ground.

rules.name: The Panel Size Rule
rules.body: Type runs from 12 to 16 px, and there is no display size. Hierarchy comes from weight (600 / 500 / 400) and from ink versus muted colour. On this page the live video carries the visual hierarchy.

rules.name: The Machinery In Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only behind a disclosure. A digest or path shown in the main reading flow is a sign that machinery has leaked into the plain-language layer.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px warm lines (`line` for containers, `line-strong` for controls). Cards are flat at rest and stay flat when emphasised. Emphasis changes the border colour, not the elevation.

dos: Do take every colour from the custom properties on `:root`, and give every new role a dark-theme value in both the `prefers-color-scheme` block and the `[data-theme="dark"]` block.
Do keep one filled ink primary per card, and use the outlined default or quiet buttons for everything else.
Do mark emphasis on a card with its paired `-line` border and a state-coloured title, not with fill or elevation.
Do keep type between 12 and 16px in system UI, separating levels by weight (600 / 500 / 400) and muted colour.
Do draw icons as inline stroke SVGs (16×16 viewBox, 1.6 stroke, round caps, 70% opacity) and chevrons as CSS borders.
Do keep controls at least 36px high with the 2px clay focus outline at a 2px offset.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: every transition and animation turns off.
donts: Don't use a hue for decoration. Clay, green, amber and red appear only when they carry state or focus.
Don't put a full-strength state hue on a card border. Use its `-line` partner.
Don't add shadows to cards, the header, or the confirmation card. Shipped depth is tone plus hairline.
Don't lighten the video stage to match the page in light theme.
Don't show monospace machine values (revisions, hashes, paths) outside a Technical details disclosure.
Don't use icon fonts, emoji, or text glyphs as icons.
